meta.source: Reserve Bank of India (via the Data Bank)
meta.revisionPolicy: Policy rates and auction results are final when announced. The Handbook restates a few effective dates between editions (newest edition wins, differences listed in rates-policy meta). Lending and deposit rates: each monthly release repeats the full history; the newest release wins.
meta.coverage: Every change in the RBI's policy rates and reserve requirements since July 1935: repo, SDF, reverse repo, MSF, Bank Rate, CRR and SLR
meta.note: One row per date on which any of the seven rates changed; each series gives the level in force from that date (a rate that did not change carries its level). Source: RBI Handbook of Statistics, Major Monetary Policy Rates and Reserve Requirements (newest edition wins over its span), then MPC resolutions, via the Data Bank's rbi_policy_rates. CRR before 1962 was printed as two ratios ('5% of demand, 2% of time liabilities') and is left empty. The repo and reverse repo follow the post-October 2004 naming throughout (repo = the RBI lending to banks).
